html:
Legal

Terms and Conditions

Please read these terms carefully before using our services.

Welcome to South Kensington Medical and Dental, referred to in this document as “the Clinic.” By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions.

About Us

The Clinic is a private medical and dental centre located in South Kensington, London. We provide a wide range of healthcare services, including GP consultations, health screening, diagnostic testing, and general and advanced dental care.

Use of the Website

You agree to use our website only for lawful purposes and in a manner that does not infringe upon the rights or restrict the use of the website by any other person.

The Clinic reserves the right to suspend or withdraw website access at any time without notice.

Medical Disclaimer

The information on our website is provided for general guidance and does not constitute medical advice. It is not a substitute for consultation with a qualified healthcare professional. If you have any health concerns, please contact a clinician directly.

Self-Request Tests

If you undergo any tests on a self-request basis, i.e., without prior consultation with one of our clinicians, the following terms apply:

  • The test results will not be reviewed or interpreted by a doctor unless you book and pay for a separate consultation.
  • The Clinic is not responsible for providing a clinical diagnosis or advising on your general health based solely on self-request test results.
  • This service is not intended for clinically urgent cases, as blood samples are sent to an external laboratory. Turnaround times are estimates and not guarantees.
  • The Clinic accepts no responsibility for self-referral tests performed without proper medical consultation, or for results affected by omission, dishonesty, or misrepresentation of relevant medical history.

We strongly recommend booking a consultation with a UK-registered medical practitioner if you have any symptoms or concerns.

Appointments and Cancellations

Appointments may be booked online, by phone, or in person. While we aim to accommodate your preferences, we cannot guarantee the availability of specific dates, times, or clinicians.

Please give at least 24 hours’ notice for cancellations. Missed appointments or cancellations made with insufficient notice may incur a charge.

Fees and Payment

Service fees are made clear at the time of booking or enquiry. Full payment is due at the time of service, unless agreed otherwise in writing. We accept most major debit and credit cards. Refunds for missed appointments are issued only at the Clinic’s discretion.

Confidentiality and Data Protection

We take your right to confidentiality seriously. All personal and medical information is handled in accordance with the UK GDPR and our Privacy Policy. Your information will only be shared when necessary for your care or where legally required.

  • Information may be shared with GPs, insurance providers, or other healthcare professionals directly involved in your care.
  • Your data may be stored securely in both digital and paper formats.
  • CCTV is used in public and communal areas for safety. It is never used in private treatment rooms without prior consent.

For further details, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Our Staff

All our staff are:

  • Fully trained and experienced for their roles
  • Registered with the appropriate professional bodies
  • Subject to thorough background checks
  • Required to follow strict clinical and ethical standards
  • Committed to ongoing professional development and delivering high-quality patient care

Behavioural Expectations

To ensure a safe and respectful environment:

  • We ask all patients to treat staff and other service users with courtesy and respect.
  • Loud, abusive, or aggressive behaviour will not be tolerated.
  • Patients under the influence of alcohol or illegal substances may be refused treatment.
  • Children must be supervised at all times. Your appointment may be cancelled if children are left unattended.

The Clinic reserves the right to refuse service or future appointments if a patient is abusive or repeatedly breaches clinic policies. Any individual who acts inappropriately may be asked to leave and may be permanently barred. Medical records may be deleted in such circumstances, in accordance with applicable regulations.

Making a Complaint or Giving Feedback

We value feedback as an opportunity to improve. You are encouraged to raise concerns, no matter how small.

  • Complaints will be taken seriously and acknowledged within 3 working days.
  • A full response will be provided within 10 working days. If this is not possible, you will be informed regarding the timeline of the response.
  • If upheld, a written apology will be issued and appropriate corrective action taken.
  • You may involve an impartial third party at any stage of the process.

Your privacy and dignity are of utmost importance to us. Please speak to a senior staff member if at any time you feel these are not being respected.

If You Remain Dissatisfied

If you are not satisfied with the outcome of our internal complaints process, you have the right to escalate your complaint to the following regulatory bodies:

General Dental Council (GDC)
The GDC regulates all dental professionals in the UK. You can raise concerns about a dental professional's fitness to practise.
Website: www.gdc-uk.org/raising-concerns
Phone: 020 7167 6000
Care Quality Commission (CQC)
The CQC monitors and inspects healthcare services in England. You can share your experience of our care.
Website: www.cqc.org.uk/contact-us
Phone: 03000 616161
Dental Complaints Service
The Dental Complaints Service is a free and independent service that helps resolve complaints about private dental care.
Website: dcs.gdc-uk.org
Phone: 020 8253 0800
Parliamentary and Health Service Ombudsman (PHSO)
If your complaint relates to NHS-funded treatment, you may escalate to the PHSO.
Website: www.ombudsman.org.uk

External Links

Links to external websites are provided for convenience only. The Clinic does not endorse and is not responsible for the content, policies, or practices of any third-party sites.

Limitation of Liability

While we make every effort to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the content on our website, the Clinic does not accept liability for errors or omissions. We are not liable for any loss or damage resulting from your reliance on information found on this website or from services provided without full clinical oversight.

Changes to These Terms

The Clinic may amend these Terms and Conditions from time to time. Any updates will be posted on this page and are effective from the date of publication. Continued use of our website or services implies your acceptance of the revised terms.

Governing Law

These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.
